fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the presence of Al "Scarface" Capone in Dade County and public reaction to him, including a reprinted summary of Capone's record from the Chicago Tribune. Additional pieces discuss efforts to undermine the police department, concerns about poisonous bootleg liquor during Prohibition, Coral Gables municipal politics and the firing of George Merrick, local civic complaints (taxi fares, sewage odors), and assorted society/news notes and advertisements.
